items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' (likely Monk Rowe, the interviewer), not the jazz pianist Thelonious Monk. No mention of Thelonious Monk is present.

ctx.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Los Angeles, and I feel very privileged to have Buddy Collette with me.
Well Monk it’s my pleasure to be invited to be a part of this, you know I was happy when you gave me a call and then you sent the letter and I’m saying boy I could hardly wait for this to happen.
Do you know that you’re one of those fellows that when you talk to other musicians, they have great reverence for you.
